request.description:
Expected HTTP 200. Optional: from, to (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO datetime with timezone), state, district, village, managerId, sellerId, paymentMode, status, groupBy (date/seller/manager/state/district/village), format (json/csv/xlsx; default json). Default status is CONFIRMED. Date-only to includes the end of that UTC day.
Optional groups array appears only with groupBy. JSON items capped at 500; CSV/XLSX at 5000. Summary aggregates all matches; groups only cover returned rows. Example totals assume the main flow. Export with ?format=csv or ?format=xlsx; expect HTTP 200 and attachment sales-report.csv/.xlsx, not JSON.
